items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: my friend Barry Galbraith just said in the amplifier, they put in more treble.

ctx.x: I didn’t know anything about an amplifier, what was an amplifier? And my friend Barry Galbraith just said in the amplifier, they put in more treble.
Barry Galbraith. He was the other part of that group.
